rationale.overall: A and B are visually indistinguishable at 1024 — same composition, same lighting, same glossy-slab-plus-paper-loop treatment, and both sit equally far from the REFERENCE's dusty matte concrete and fine surface grain, so neither earns the win.
rationale.material: Both render the slab with the same soft vertical value gradient, identical bevel highlight and warm bounce from the base glow, and both smooth away the REFERENCE's speckled stone tooth and translucent tape striation to the same degree; the only differences are sub-threshold shifts in background texture contrast.
rationale.silhouette: The block, its rounded corners, the tape loop and the diagonal ground split occupy the same shape and angle in both takes, with no difference in edge definition or figure/ground separation.
rationale.smallsize: At 128, 32 and 16px the two strips collapse to the same read — dark angled bar, orange underline, faint loop above-left — with the loop dissolving into an ambiguous smudge in both.
